name: Crash Zoom — Product Reveal
description: Aggressive crash zoom from wide to macro detail on a hero product, studio lighting.
thumbnailPrompt: dramatic crash zoom onto a premium product on a dark pedestal, studio rim lighting, shallow depth of field
promptTemplate: Crash zoom shot: camera starts on a wide locked-off frame of {subject} placed on {surface}, then executes an aggressive, fast crash zoom punching in to an extreme macro close-up of the product surface. Premium studio product cinematography, full frame cine digital camera, 100mm macro lens, f/2.8 shallow depth of field, hard key light with soft rim light, deep black background, subtle floating dust particles catching the light, ultra sharp focus on the product, high-end commercial look.
negativePrompt: hands, people, text, watermark, logo distortion, warped geometry, blur on product, low quality

referenceImages.hint: One clean photo of the product on a neutral background works best.
